instruction_units.title: 1. LH Leap To Chord
instruction_units.instruction: The left hand moves from Ab4 on m.58, beat 2.25 to an Eb3-Gb3-C4 chord on m.58, beat 4.

instruction_units.title: 2. Melody with accompaniment
instruction_units.instruction: Both hands form a melody-with-accompaniment texture at m.58: one layer carries the melodic line while another supplies aligned support. Melody Bb4-Eb5 over accompaniment Bb3.

instruction_units.title: 3. LH Chord Landing
instruction_units.instruction: The left hand sounds Eb3-Gb3-C4 (3 notes, span 9 semitones) on m.58, beat 4.
